fullTextZH: 今天我要跟你们说一件
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell you about something
I worked at a university in Beijing

fullTextZH: 他们都是从美国来学习中文的大学生
fullTextEN: They are all university students from America studying Chinese

fullTextZH: 我觉得我永远都不会忘记他
fullTextEN: I think I will never forget him

fullTextZH: 还有一件事情他们非常不喜欢
fullTextEN: There is one more thing they really dislike
which is going to the bathroom

fullTextZH: 上厕所就是尿尿和拉屎
fullTextEN: Going to the bathroom means peeing and pooping

fullTextZH: 他是一个非常帅的男生
fullTextEN: He is a very handsome boy

fullTextZH: 我们所有的女老师都很喜欢和他上课
fullTextEN: All our female teachers really like having class with him

fullTextZH: 可是他每天上课都会说
fullTextEN: But he speaks in every class every day.

fullTextZH: 老师我可以去上厕所吗
fullTextEN: Teacher, can I go to the bathroom?

fullTextZH: 他真的每天都去上厕所
fullTextEN: He really goes to the bathroom every day.
How long does he spend in the bathroom?

fullTextZH: 他每天都要去厕所半个小时
fullTextEN: He goes to the bathroom for half an hour every day.

fullTextZH: 我觉得为什么他要去厕所这么长时间
fullTextEN: I wonder why he spends so long in the bathroom.
Or does he go a lot?
He went to the bathroom and forgot to bring paper.
When I saw him coming back
There is a lot of sweat on the face

fullTextZH: 我觉得他一定是拉不出来
fullTextEN: I think he must be constipated
So he exerted a lot of effort
But he is a handsome guy
I want to hear him say another reason
I don't want to hear this reason

fullTextZH: 你为什么每天都要去厕所这么长时间
fullTextEN: Why do you spend so much time in the bathroom every day?

fullTextZH: 因为我要回房间上厕所
fullTextEN: Because I want to go back to the room to use the bathroom
But the room is very far

fullTextZH: 你为什么要回房间上厕所
fullTextEN: Why do you want to go back to the room to use the bathroom?
I need to use the toilet.

fullTextZH: 很快的跑回房间上厕所
fullTextEN: Quickly run back to the room to use the toilet.
Then run back to class again.

fullTextZH: 所以为什么他流很多汗
fullTextEN: So why does he sweat a lot?

fullTextZH: 他在中国上厕所太难了
fullTextEN: It's too difficult for him to use the toilet in China.
Can you squat to use the toilet?

fullTextZH: 在中国很多地方都有马桶
fullTextEN: There are toilets in many places in China.
You don't need to squat to use the toilet.
